caption: The loop starts with an app.css edit in VS Code: git status lists app.css and logo.svg, git add stages both, and the commit stays in local .git until git push. DevTools Network then shows 34 KB transferred, with the cached app.css adding 0 KB and one favicon 404.

spec.title: Edit to inspect loop
spec.aria: Flow from an app.css edit in VS Code through git status listing app.css and logo.svg, git add staging two files, a local-only git commit, a git push to origin main, and DevTools Network showing 34 KB transferred and one favicon 404.
